title: [Bug] RTX 5070 Ti (sm_120) not recognized by PyTorch 2.5.1+cu121
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

My GPU (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti, CUDA capability sm_120) is not recognized by current PyTorch builds.
The latest official release supports up to sm_90 only.

**Environment details:**
- PyTorch version: 2.5.1+cu121
- CUDA runtime: 13.0.88
- Driver version: 576.88
- Python: 3.10.11
- OS: Windows 11 Pro
- GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (Ada-Next architecture)

**Error message:**


**Expected behavior:**
PyTorch should recognize and utilize this GPU (sm_120) with full CUDA acceleration, similar to other Ada Lovelace cards.

**Steps to reproduce:**
```python
import torch
print(torch.__version__)
print(torch.cuda.is_available())
print(torch.cuda.get_device_name(0))
